result:
Perfect! The tests pass. The fix is complete. The issue was that the `update()` method in `PostController` was returning a 302 redirect status code after saving an edit. HTTP 302 tells the browser to follow the redirect using the same HTTP method (PUT), which creates an infinite loop because the `/posts/:id` endpoint only accepts GET requests. By changing it to 303 (See Other), the browser correctly follows the redirect with a GET request, navigating to the post page after a successful save—matching the behavior of the `store()` method which publishes a new post.

**Summary of changes:**

Changed the redirect status code in `PostController.update()` from 302 to 303. HTTP 303 (See Other) instructs the browser to follow the redirect with a GET request, preventing the redirect loop that occurred when 302 caused the browser to repeat the PUT request. This aligns the edit-save behavior with the publish-new behavior and resolves the infinite redirect error.
